claim: For MSK Provisioned clusters to be highly available during an update (such as a broker size or Apache Kafka version update) or when Amazon MSK replaces a broker, AWS recommends a three-AZ cluster, a replication factor of at least 3, and minimum in-sync replicas set to at most the replication factor minus 1.

evidence.quote: Use the following recommendations so that your MSK Provisioned clusters can be highly available during an update (such as when you're updating the broker size or Apache Kafka version, for example) or when Amazon MSK is replacing a broker.
Ensure that the replication factor (RF) is at least 3. Note that a RF of 1 can lead to offline partitions during a rolling update; and a RF of 2 may lead to data loss.

Set minimum in-sync replicas (minISR) to at most RF - 1. A minISR that is equal to the RF can prevent producing to the cluster during a rolling update. A minISR of 2 allows three-way replicated topics to be available when one replica is offline.
